user.title: UGREEN PowerRoam
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should talk to your power station.

cloud.title: Connect your UGREEN account
cloud.description: Telemetry arrives about every 15 seconds and needs an internet connection.

bluetooth_pick.title: Select your PowerRoam
bluetooth_pick.description: Choose the power station to connect to over Bluetooth.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up {name} over Bluetooth
bluetooth_confirm.description:
Home Assistant will connect directly to {name}. No UGREEN account or internet connection is needed, and status updates arrive within a second.

Close the UGREEN phone app while setting up: the power station accepts only one Bluetooth connection at a time.

abort.no_devices_found: No PowerRoam found. Check that the power station is switched on and in range of a Bluetooth adapter, and that the UGREEN app is not currently connected to it.
